Method of Attack: SEO poisoning to infect targets with a remote access trojan (RAT)
Runs in memory and drops other payloads on infected devices
Provides backdoor access to compromised systems
Exfiltrates harvested data to command-and-control server
Gains persistence by adding itself to Startup folder and modifying desktop shortcuts
Flooding search results with over 100,000 web pages claiming to provide free office forms
Drive-by downloads and search redirection via Shopify and Google Sites
Keyword-stuffed PDF documents with SEO keywords and links leading to malware
Redirection through multiple websites using .site, .tk, and .ga TLDs to a cloned Google Drive page serving the malware
Impacted Systems: Business professionals searching for document templates
Attack Vector: SEO poisoning via malicious web pages and documents
Redirection through multiple websites and cloned Google Drive page
Indicators of Compromise: Over 100,000 malicious web pages with free office form templates
Keyword-stuffed PDF documents with >10 pages of SEO keywords
Use of .site, .tk, and .ga top-level domains in redirection chain
Cloned Google Drive web page serving final payload
